decisions.reason: Custom furniture remains somewhat peripheral, but its sheltered-workshop mission fit and the firm's continued organisational slack make retention more likely unless results clearly fall below aspiration levels.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the core mental-health support offer, so management is likely to keep it while using another year of experience to judge it against internal and peer aspirations.
Counseling for senior living fits the firm's eldercare capabilities and strategic positioning well, making a withdrawal unlikely absent a clear performance shortfall.
The retail shop is mission-linked through sheltered-workshop activity but still more peripheral and commercially exposed than care services, so it stays on the market with moderate review risk.

Meal delivery for seniors is close to the core offer and can use existing care relationships, so boundedly rational management would usually keep it for now despite the uncertainty of a recent launch.
